## Begonecia

A Control Center toggle that silences the **microphone, camera and location** across the whole system. When it's on, apps don't get a permission error — they just get nothing: zeroed mic audio, no camera frames, no location callbacks. A silent blackout, not a visible denial.

Toggle it from Control Center; add the tile in Settings → Control Center.

- **iOS 17 support:** iOS 17 moved audio processing to a new background service; Begonecia now covers it too.
- **A12 and newer confirmed:** on an iPhone SE (2nd gen) with iOS 17.5.1, recording apps get pure silence with Begonecia on and normal sound with it off, and Siri hears nothing.
- Still in this version: Siri silenced (since rootless4).

**A12 and newer: supported and confirmed.** Earlier builds put A12+ devices (iPhone XS / XR and later) into safe mode; the current builds are made with Xcode's toolchain and are tested on a real A12+ device.

- Tested on an **iPhone SE (2nd gen, A13)** with iOS 17.5.1 (arm64e) and an **iPhone 8 Plus (A11)** with iOS 16.7, both with Dopamine. On iOS 17, apps and Siri get complete silence with Begonecia on (measured).
- **If it ever puts you into safe mode:** open Sileo (safe mode still allows it), uninstall it and please [report back](https://github.com/Jond-ie/repo/issues).

- The mic silencer targets the common capture path; verify on your setup.
- Jailbreaking lowers your device's baseline security — this hardens privacy, it doesn't undo that.
- Requires **CCSupport** (com.opa334.ccsupport), **Cephei** (ws.hbang.common, from Chariz), and **ellekit** (ships with Dopamine).
- Tested on an **iPhone 8 Plus (A11, arm64)** with iOS 16.7. A12 and newer: see Device Support.
